Each AUROC uses up to 8,000 sampled non-target cells, drawn from one random stream that runs through the methods in alphabetical order. Without the internal variants' marker lists (not included), the 32 scran and Seurat methods that follow them draw different samples: their mean transfer AUROC changes by at most 0.001 and mean retention by at most 0.023, while on-target recovery and every value shown in Supplementary Fig. 9a are unchanged (both versions rerun). The tables used for the figures are those of the original run.

candidate_markers.py, panel_rules.py, build_panels.py and counts/construction_counts.py keep only the rules of the final marker panels; earlier rule variants and the review columns of the first panel version are removed. Rerun on the CellMarker 3.0 export, they rebuild the 97 panels (1,572 subtype-gene pairs) and the construction counts exactly.

The scoring chain reads only the final marker panels and the inputs that link_inputs.sh links under plain names; options for earlier panel versions and a second reader of the comparators' result files (RDS) are removed. fill_unfinished.py is new: it does in one step what two steps did in the original run, one for the original and one for the added lineages, with the same rule. Rerun on the stored inputs, the chain reproduces every table of the original run value for value.
